problems.name: P vs NP
problems.blocking_gap: Three barrier theorems (relativization, natural proofs, algebrization) rule out every known technique; current circuit lower bounds do not reach NP.
problems.transmuted_approach: Borrow the Poincare pattern - a deformation with a monotone quantity and controlled singularities - as an analogy only, then pursue geometric complexity theory (representation-theoretic obstructions), which is deliberately non-relativizing and non-naturalizing. Dead end to check first: occurrence obstructions already block the simplest GCT programme.

problems.name: Hodge Conjecture
problems.blocking_gap: The integral form is false (Atiyah-Hirzebruch torsion, Kollar); the rational form has no general construction of algebraic cycles in codimension two and higher.
problems.transmuted_approach: Use Poincare-style reduction to a normal form: replace cycle construction with a deformation of the Hodge structure (variation of Hodge structure) and ask which classes are invariant under monodromy. Test on the known counterexamples before general claims.

problems.name: Riemann Hypothesis
problems.blocking_gap: No archimedean positivity and no exact trace formula for the integers; the function field analogue is settled, the number field case is not.
problems.transmuted_approach: De Bruijn-Newman flow: zeros evolve under a heat-type equation; RH is equivalent to Lambda = 0, and Lambda >= 0 is a theorem (Rodgers-Tao). The missing piece is a monotone quantity at t = 0, which is the same shape of gap that Ricci flow had.

problems.name: Yang-Mills Existence and Mass Gap
problems.blocking_gap: No nonperturbative construction of a four-dimensional gauge theory, and no control of the renormalization group flow sufficient to prove a gap.
problems.transmuted_approach: Constructor path: Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction plus a rigorous Wilsonian renormalization group flow; the monotone quantity is the effective action under scale. Test the flow on the lattice first, where the gap is already seen numerically.

problems.name: Navier-Stokes Existence and Smoothness
problems.blocking_gap: The equation is supercritical: the energy is invariant at the critical scaling and no monotone quantity rules out blow-up in three dimensions.
problems.transmuted_approach: Critical-space scaling: work in the scaling-invariant norm and look for a monotone (or at least non-increasing) functional along the flow, as with Ricci flow entropy. Dead end to record: mere energy methods cannot work, they are supercritical.

problems.name: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
problems.blocking_gap: Rank zero and one are known through Gross-Zagier and Kolyvagin; rank two and above need Euler systems or p-adic constructions that do not exist in general.
problems.transmuted_approach: Euler systems are the working analogue of a monotone quantity: each level yields a divisibility that improves with rank. Dead end: rank two Euler systems are not available; p-adic Iwasawa theory covers only parts of the picture.
